section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study consisting of 1012 adolescents and young adults (482 boys, 530 girls) recruited from three countries: Denmark (n=129), Portugal (n=513), and Sweden (n=370). Participants ranged in age from 12 to 19 years with a mean age of 15.1 years (SD=1.9), and self-reported BMI ranged from 11.72 to 51.14 kg/m² with a mean of 21.01 (SD=3.57). Significant differences in age and BMI were found across the three countries.
